analysis.title: The Point for North America, Tuesday, 17 November 2026
key_insights: Citi reiterates Vertiv (VRT) as a top pick in Multi-Industrials after a management meeting ahead of SuperCompute 2026. Management commented positively on demand visibility, order pipeline health and adoption of converged infrastructure. VRT is down ~50% from its 52-week high, and Citi says valuation offers an attractive risk/reward.

Citi's VRT scenario table: Citi's DC GAINS model implies 24% GW CAGR (2025-2030E), 2030E organic adj. EPS of $16.35 and a 2030E P/E of 11.5x on the 11/16/2026 share price. VisibleAlpha consensus 2030E EPS is $16.04.

e.l.f. Beauty (ELF): Citi reiterates Buy after a meeting with the CEO and CFO. It sees potential upside to conservative F2H27 guidance from rhode momentum, haircare/fragrance expansion and improving core e.l.f. categories.

GXO Logistics (GXO) Investor Day targets: above-market +7% organic revenue growth through 2030, >240bps EBITA margin expansion, >20% adj. EPS CAGR, 40-50% FCF conversion, and over $2.0bn of FCF in 2027-2030 for debt paydown and buybacks. Citi says the targets beat its expectations and rates GXO Buy. The stock trades under 16x consensus '27e adj. EPS with a $6.5B market cap. Citi notes investors may stay skeptical given GXO's mixed record of hitting targets.

Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX): after attending Starship Flight 15 (successful catch of the Starship), Citi raised 4Q26/1H27 revenue and adj. EBITDA estimates, mainly in the Super Intelligence segment. It raised its price target from $240 to $280 and cites a multi-year path toward $900+.

Eli Lilly (LLY) is acquiring private Calytrix Bio, a preclinical mCALR antibody for essential thrombocythemia and myelofibrosis, for up to $1.5B in upfront and milestone payments (upfront not disclosed). Citi sees negligible near-term valuation impact, and maintains Buy and a $1,650 target.

Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) is acquiring private Ollin Biosciences for $2.2B upfront plus up to $1.125B in milestones. The lead asset OLN324 is a late-stage VEGF/Ang2 bispecific for DME and wet AMD, and Blackstone will contribute $750M to the Ph3 program. The deal is expected to close by YE26E, and Citi reiterates Buy.

T-Mobile US (TMUS): Citi raised its target to $185 after the recent share price outperformance, citing more balanced sentiment on telcos, stabilizing wireless competition, a non-zero chance SpaceX enters mobile as a builder or Telco buyer, and cost and synergy upside to its 2027 Core Adjusted EBITDA outlook.

NextEra (NEE): five Virginia Democratic House members filed opposition to the merger at the SCC and FERC. Citi views this as largely noise and is not worried about the outcome ahead of the SCC hearing on Tuesday (the day after the note).
EchoStar (ECHO) target raised to $156 from $139 to follow Citi's SPCX target increase from $240 to $280. Citi stays Buy on potential spectrum monetization catalysts.

Zoom (ZM): partner checks and the analyst day support Citi's expectation of a modest 2H acceleration. Citi sees Zoom clearing the high end of topline estimates in 3Q and raising full-year targets. It reiterates Buy and a $131 target.

Nextpower (NXT) CMD: FY30 revenue guidance of >$7.5B was ahead of Citi's above-consensus estimate. The FY30 adj. EBITDA margin target of >21% was in line with Citi but below consensus of ~23%. Tracker targets were unchanged. Citi sees a potential bull-case value of ~$140/share by 2030.

Citi's October web and app traffic data: Instagram U.S. time spent per DAU rose 10% y/y to 57 minutes, and Meta's Muse was the #1 downloaded iOS app. Google's worldwide search share rose 110bps m/m to 91.0% and U.S. share rose 30bps to 85.5%. Etsy U.S. traffic grew 33% y/y (vs 28% in September) and Wayfair's grew 41% (vs 67%). Top picks: AMZN, META, GOOGL, ABNB, CVNA.
Chemical Distillate: Citi says the export polyethylene market is turning more cautious on lower energy prices (weekly commentary).
Retail same-day delivery: TSCO launched on Uber Marketplace/UberEats, and COST management discussed expanded DoorDash/UberEats partnerships. Walmart, Target and Best Buy have in-house drivers.

China's 2026 NRDL takes effect January 1, 2027. Citi sees first-time inclusions of ZLAB's KarXT and Vyvgart Hytrulo and AAPG's Lisaftoclax as in line with its expectations and favorable overall. It models an additional ~5% price concession on Vyvgart Hytrulo and expects 4Q26 sales pressure from channel inventory adjustments.
Citi Flows: USD saw net outflows last week as bank and real money selling outweighed leveraged buying. EM aggregate flows were close to flat, with Asia and CEEMEA seeing outflows and LatAm inflows.

earnings_insights: Zoom (ZM): Citi expects 3Q FY27 results to clear the high end of topline estimates and full-year targets to be raised. Citi's 3Q FY27E revenue is $1,297M vs consensus $1,296M, with company guidance of $1,300-1,310M. Citi's FY27E revenue is $5,092M vs consensus $5,090M. Citi's 3Q EPS estimate is $1.55 vs consensus $1.54. These are estimates, not reported results.
Nextpower (NXT) CMD, reported 11/16: FY30 revenue guidance >$7.5B vs Citi's above-consensus estimate, and FY30 adj. EBITDA margin target >21% vs consensus ~23%.
GXO: Investor Day targets of +7% organic revenue growth through 2030, >20% adj. EPS CAGR and 40-50% FCF conversion. Citi says these were above its expectations.
Vertiv (VRT) scenario analysis: consensus (VisibleAlpha) 2028E organic adj. EPS is $12.33 and 2030E is $16.04.
e.l.f. Beauty: Citi sees potential upside to F2H27 guidance, which it calls conservative. The company's recent organic sales growth (OSG) series is in the report charts only.
China NRDL: Citi expects 4Q26 Vyvgart sales pressure from channel inventory adjustments and rebate obligations tied to the IV-to-subcutaneous transition.
risk_factors: VRT: increased macro-related uncertainty relative to the start of the year, with the stock down ~50% from its 52-week high.
GXO: investors may stay skeptical of the targets given a mixed record of hitting them under prior management.
LLY/Calytrix: the program is preclinical and the safety bar will be high in indolent ET.
NXT: unchanged tracker targets and an adj. EBITDA margin target below consensus.
ZLAB/Vyvgart Hytrulo: NRDL inclusion brings price concessions and 4Q26 sales pressure.

tension_points.bull_case: Citi sees targets above its expectations, with multiple levers including geographic expansion, strategic verticals and automation. Management called them conservative, and Citi sees multiple appreciation as GXO shows progress.
tension_points.bear_case: Given GXO's mixed track record of achieving targets under different management, investors may keep healthy skepticism.
tension_points.what_invalidates: GXO failing to show progress toward its 2030 targets would undercut the multiple-appreciation case.
